The wafer was made at Taiwan Semiconductor's facility in Arizona.  "TSMC is an incredible partner in -- a strategic partner for United States and in bringing manufacturing of the most -- in most critical sector of technology here to United States," Huang told Fox News' The Sunday Briefing.
